The '''LAAT/le patrol gunship''', also known as the '''Republic police gunship''' and later known as the '''Imperial patrol transport''', was a [[gunship]] introduced during the [[Clone Wars]] to perform [[Law enforcement agency|law enforcement]] functions on the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] [[capital]] of [[Coruscant]]. Designed to be sleeker and smaller as well as less heavily armed than the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|Republic attack gunship]], the patrol transport was better suited for policing the dense, [[planet]]-wide [[city]] while reducing the risks of collateral damage.

After the formation of the [[Galactic Empire]], the patrol transport saw a broader use as a patrol craft for the [[Imperial Military]] on various worlds, as well as an escort carried on some of its [[capital ship]]s. Patrol transports saw extensive use against various rebel cells and factions during both the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early Rebellion]] and the [[Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:PoliceGunship-CGSWG.png|thumb|left|300px|The LAAT/le patrol gunship during the [[Republic Era]]]]
The LAAT/le patrol gunship<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files" /> was the civilian model of the [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry|LAAT/i gunship]] and was sleeker, smaller, and less heavily armed.<ref name="Databank" /> Designed for crowd control, the [[gunship]] was fast, maneuverable and armed with light but efficient weaponry, making it ideal for law enforcement in heavily built-up locales.<ref name="BtMF">[[Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon 82|''Star Wars: Build the Millennium Falcon'' 82]]</ref> The police [[gunship]] possessed a spoked [[cockpit]] and [[Solar collector|solar gatherer panels]] which acted as the [[power generator]] for the [[Starship|ship]]. Two ball-mounted [[laser cannon]]s were underneath the cockpit and one [[laser]] [[cannon]] was mounted on the rear of the ship which were better suited for patrolling the [[city]] scape as well as having a lower risk overall in causing collateral damage.<ref name="Databank" />

The patrol transports were also equipped with searchlights in the event that they had to conduct searches at night or in areas of [[Coruscant]] where visibility was low, such as the [[Coruscant Underworld|underworld]]. The gunship's cockpit also had two seats for the [[pilot]] and [[gunner]], with the pilot being slightly behind of and elevated over the gunner. The side hatches opened for entry, and had a ramp near the rear in the event that the circumstances required rapid deployment of its personnel.<ref name="Databank" />

The patrol transport was armed with ball-mounted [[turret]]s and fixed cannons. A [[troop]] bay allowed for the rapid deployment of [[police officer]]s. Though utilized primarily by the [[Coruscant Security Force]], the patrol transport also was available to the [[Coruscant Guard]] [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]] who could procure them if need be. Following the formation of the Galactic Empire, the patrol transport was used as a patrol craft and as an escort carried on some [[capital ship]]s.<ref name="Databank" />

==History==
===Clone Wars===
[[File:Police_Gunship_SaV.png|thumb|left|220px|A clone shock trooper stands in front of a police gunship.]]
The LAAT/le was manufactured by the [[Santhe Corporation]] and [[Rothana Heavy Engineering]]<ref name="Scum and Villainy Case Files">''[[Star Wars: Scum and Villainy: Case Files on the Galaxy's Most Notorious]]''</ref> initially for the forces of the [[Galactic Republic]] for use on the [[ecumenopolis]] [[Coruscant]], although it would also come to be used by the [[Coruscant Guard]] and [[Jedi Order]].<ref name="BtMF" /> During the [[Clone Wars]] it was available to both flesh-and-blood police officers and the [[GU-series Guardian police droid]]s of the Coruscant Security Force, as well as the [[Imperial shock trooper|shock troopers]] of the Coruscant Guard.<ref name="SWE" />

Two of these gunships were used on Coruscant by two teams of Coruscant Guards led by [[Cloning|clone]] [[officer]]s [[Clone Captain|Captain]] [[Rex]] and [[Clone Commander|Commander]] [[Wolffe]] and [[Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Plo Koon]] to search for Skywalker's [[padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] in the lower levels, after Tano [[Escape from the Republic military base|escaped]] from the [[Imperial Inspectorate HQ|Republic Center for Military Operations]].<ref name="To Catch a Jedi">{{TCW|To Catch a Jedi}}</ref>

The gunships were utilized by several [[trooper]]s of the Coruscant Guard to search the [[planet]] for the [[clone trooper]] [[Fives]]. They eventually found him in a warehouse in the lower levels where he was shot by them.<ref name="Orders">{{TCW|Orders (episode)}}</ref> Some were stationed in the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple's]] [[hangar]].<ref name="Voices">{{TCW|Voices}}</ref>

===Age of the Empire===
[[File:ImperialTIEPilot-SWL81.png|thumb|right|300px|The LAAT/le became a major component of Imperial operations as the Imperial Patrol Transport.]]
Following the [[Proclamation of the New Order|creation]] of the [[Galactic Empire]], the vessel was renamed to the Imperial Patrol Transport and sent to every far flung corner of [[the galaxy]] by Imperial [[commander]]s in order to ensure the citizens of the new Empire were brought to heel.<ref name="BtMF" /> The gunship was used by the [[Imperial Military]] on various planets such as [[Lothal]] as a patrol craft to help in putting down rebellious activity.<ref name="Call to Action" /> Some were also held on [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]], such as [[Admiral]] [[Kassius Konstantine]]'s ''[[Relentless]]''<ref name="Relics" /> and [[Captain]] [[Slavin]]'s [[Slavin's Star Destroyer|Star Destroyer]], the latter of which used them to [[Mission to Faos Station|assist]] a [[Freighter 2716|freighter]] in docking with it.<ref name="Name">{{Rebels|In the Name of the Rebellion}}</ref>

In [[19 BBY]], one transport was used by early members of the [[Partisans]] to try and evacuate civilians from [[Onderon]], though they were swiftly defeated by [[Crosshair]] and his [[Elite Squad]].<ref name="Replacementss">{{TBB|Replacements}}</ref>

In [[14 BBY]], one such transport was dispatched to the [[Tomb of Miktrull]] to deploy a [[Purge Trooper]] to hunt down [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]].<ref name="Fallen Order" />

A downed patrol transport was found in the [[Rambler's Reach Outpost]] region on [[9 BBY]].<ref>[[Star Wars Jedi: Survivor]]</ref>

[[File:Police_gunships_Lothal.png|thumb|left|300px|Two patrol transports on Lothal.]]
Patrol transports were stationed at an [[Lothal Imperial airfield|Imperial airfield]] which served as a testing ground for [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn's]] [[TIE/D Defender Elite]] prototype. Patrol transports were later used to search for the wrecked prototype and the fugitive rebels [[Ezra Bridger]] and [[Sabine Wren]]. However, the rebels managed to stay ahead of their Imperial pursuers.<ref name="FOTD">{{Rebels|Flight of the Defender}}</ref> Thrawn's [[Noghri]] [[assassin]] [[Rukh]] later arrived on a patrol transport to hunt down the [[Spectres]] and [[Ryder Azadi]]'s [[Lothal resistance group|rebel cell]].<ref name="Kindred">{{Rebels|Kindred}}</ref>

Patrol transports were later dispatched to investigate an [[Hijacking of Crawler 413-24|incident]] aboard the [[Mining Guild]] [[ore crawler]] [[Crawler 413-24]]. However, the rebels managed to deceive their Imperial captors by posing as Mining Guild personnel and indentured prisoners.<ref name="Crawler Commandeers">{{Rebels|Crawler Commandeers}}</ref> [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] rode a patrol transport during [[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]]'s [[Attack on Lothal|failed airstrike]] against the [[Imperial Armory Complex]].<ref name="Rebel Assault">{{Rebels|Rebel Assault}}</ref>

After Hera and [[Kanan Jarrus]] escaped the "[[Imperial Complex (Lothal)|Dome]]," the Empire dispatched three gunships after them. Ezra and Sabine hijacked one and shot down the other gunships. They then rendezvoused with Hera and Kanan at the [[Lothal City fuel depot]]. Governor Pryce then attacked the fuel depot with [[All Terrain Armored Transport (Prototype)|AT-AT walkers]]. Kanan was killed but managed to use the Force to protect his rebel comrades from the explosive wave.<ref name="Jedi Night">{{Rebels|Jedi Night}}</ref> The other rebels escaped on their stolen patrol transport to the [[Lothal cliff dwelling]].<ref name="DUME">{{Rebels|DUME}}</ref>

Governor Pryce later brought a fleet of patrol transports carrying stormtroopers and [[Jumptrooper]]s to attack the Lothal cliff dwelling, which served as the base of the Lothal rebels. Though the gunships and stormtroopers succeeded in overwhelming the base's defenses, Pryce's forces were defeated when General Syndulla arrived with reinforcements. Pryce's remaining gunships were shot down and the Governor herself was taken prisoner.<ref name="A Fool's Hope">{{Rebels|A Fool's Hope}}</ref> The rebels later used two captured gunships to infiltrate the "Dome" during the [[Liberation of Lothal]]. Rukh also used a gunship to return to the base while Ezra used a gunship to fly aboard the Star Destroyer ''[[Chimaera]]'' to meet with Thrawn.<ref name="Family Reunion" />

During the Imperial occupation of [[Mon Cala]], the patrol transports were used to scout territory. One such gunship came across the secret rendezvous between [[Regent]] [[Dors Urtya]] and [[Heroes of Yavin|Leia Organa's team]]. The [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]] approached the boarded stormtroopers with a bribe, and during the distraction, blew it up with a [[thermal detonator]].<ref name="SW 44">[[Star Wars (2015) 44|''Star Wars'' (2015) 44]]</ref>

The gunships were also found on [[Sergia]]. A patrol was close to discovering the Rebel base there, but the stormtroopers were distracted by [[Commander]] [[Luke Skywalker]], who rammed a stolen speeder into the craft, downing it so the base staff could escape.<ref name="SW 73">[[Star Wars (2015) 73|''Star Wars'' (2015) 73]]</ref>

Doctor [[Chelli Lona Aphra]]'s heavily modified LAAT/le patrol gunship was equipped with its own [[hyperdrive]].<ref name="Aphra">[[Doctor Aphra (2016) 15|''Doctor Aphra'' (2016) 15]]</ref>

===Age of the New Republic===
[[File:LAATleDeploysTroops-DreamsandMadness.png|thumb|300px|right|Night Troopers deployed from LAAT/le patrol gunship.]]
LAAT/le gunships could still be found in the service of both New Republic and Imperial Remnant forces after the [[Battle of Jakku]].<ref name="Chapter 19" /> In [[9 ABY]],<ref name="Mando S3 Date">{{MandoDate|17}}</ref> New Republic police gunships took part in the arrest of Doctor [[Penn Pershing]] on [[Coruscant]]<ref name="Chapter 19" /> as well as the arrests of Imperial loyalists working in the [[Santhe Shipyards]] on [[Corellia]].<ref name="Toil and Trouble">{{Ahsoka|Part Two: Toil and Trouble}}</ref> Imperial patrol transports were also utilized by Grand Admiral Thrawn on the extragalactic planet [[Peridea]], being used to deploy two squadrons of [[Night Trooper]]s into battle.<ref name="Dreams and Madness">{{Ahsoka|Part Seven: Dreams and Madness}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic police gunship first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Five|Season Five]] episode "[[To Catch a Jedi]]", which aired on [[February 24]], [[2013]]. The ship was originally designed for another ''Star Wars''-related project, and was inherited by the ''The Clone Wars'' team for use in this episode. Concept art for the episode was done by [[Hyunwoo Lim]] and they were nicknamed "Republic helicopter".<ref name="SW-To Catch a Jedi - The Clone Wars Episode Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep519|text="To Catch a Jedi" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref>
